item.title: Last Week In Growth E002
item.description: So last week I posted the first episode in the series and made some ambitious promises. I did not keep my word for most of them. But, that's why I have this blog. I like that I have the evidence for my progress or lack thereof now publically available. Let's see if next week can be better. I've resolved to give this blog a similar structure as /lwic. I'll be writing some updates from me.

item.title: Last Week In Growth E001
item.description: This is the first post in this series. I have no idea if its the last. It could be. My past experience doing such kinds of challenges says it possibly is. But, who am I to pull the plug on what could be. Had the same sentinment for lwic and 8 weeks later, it still stands. May the force be with it. So in this series of posts, a weekly series, I will be sharing updates on progress getting better in a variety of life domains.
